theme: The Denial Came First - Volume II
title: The Verdict
stamp: Ask who decided. Ask for the record.

scenes.text: Deny. Attack. Reverse who’s the victim. There’s an acronym for it, which is how you know it’s common. It’s a pattern worth noticing, not proof of anything by itself.
The antidote is boring. Dates. Names of whoever decided. The text of the decision. The recordings. Paper beats tone every time.
So keep the timeline, keep asking the same plain question, and let the record do the talking.
